title: China Launches National Data Group for $300B AI Infrastructure Plan
summary:
The central government in Beijing now directly administers a new state owned company tasked with the development and utilization of data resources. This entity, known as the National Data Group, is a state owned enterprise created to consolidate data assets and strengthen the technological framework required for artificial intelligence.

The launch coincides with plans to invest roughly $300 billion in data centers over the next 5 years. This centralized approach aims to foster technological breakthroughs and ensure the necessary data infrastructure is in place to meet the nation's broader AI ambitions.
